result.summary: The page is mostly well-structured, but one section heading renders a raw localization key instead of human-readable text, which is the most visually broken element. There are also a couple of minor styling inconsistencies in the restaurant cards.

issues.description: The second section heading displays the raw i18n key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a translated label (e.g. 'Popular near you'), while the sibling section correctly shows 'Fastest near you'.
issues.suggestion: Add the missing translation string for 'home_feed.popular_title' in all locale files and ensure a human-readable fallback is rendered when a key is missing.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) button treatment is inconsistent between cards: on the ramen card the heart sits directly on the image with no background, while on the pizza card it has a dark circular scrim. On light imagery the un-scrimmed white heart would be hard to see.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same semi-transparent circular background/scrim to the heart button on every card for consistent appearance and reliable contrast.

issues.description: Secondary metadata text such as '€0.90 delivery' and '25–35 min · €0 delivery · Ramen' uses light grey on white, which appears close to or below the 4.5:1 contrast ratio for small text.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text color (e.g. to around #5A5F66) so small metadata text meets WCAG AA contrast.
